title: Enterprise License Administration Guide
text: License assignment, reassignment, and administrative approval events must be recorded for audit and compliance review. Audit records should include the customer, license, action, actor, and timestamp.

title: Subscription Lifecycle Guide
text: Cancellation requests must follow the applicable subscription agreement and billing terms. Customers should review the effective cancellation date, applicable fees, and any remaining contractual obligations before submitting a request.

title: Subscription Lifecycle Guide

title: Subscription Lifecycle Guide
text: Certain licensing offers are available only in eligible geographic regions. Customer eligibility must be verified against the specific offer before a purchase or assignment is approved.

title: Subscription Lifecycle Guide
text: A customer account must be active and verified before new licenses can be assigned. Regional eligibility and account verification are separate checks, and passing one check does not imply that the other requirement has been satisfied.
